pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\8. KAPLAN MOCK-1100 MCQs\Mock Exam 2 - Answers.pdf
question_en: Derivatives pricing is based on the assumption that:
option_b: the law of one price holds.
option_c: long and short investors are net risk-neutral.
explanation_en: Derivatives pricing is based on no-arbitrage pricing and replication, and therefore assumes the law of one price holds (i.e., two assets or portfolios with the same future payoffs must have the same price). Derivatives pricing does not assume long and short investors are net risk-neutral; rather, it determines no-arbitrage derivative prices using risk-neutral pricing.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\8. KAPLAN MOCK-1100 MCQs\Mock Exam 3 - Answers.pdf
question_en: A direct investment in a cryptocurrency is said to occur when:
option_a: a transaction is recorded on the blockchain.
option_b: the purchase of a cryptocurrency stock is settled.
option_c: an investor takes a position in a cryptocurrency futures contract.
explanation_en: Direct investment in cryptocurrencies occurs when a transaction is recorded on the blockchain. Cryptocurrency stocks and cryptocurrency futures are indirect investments.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\8. KAPLAN MOCK-1100 MCQs\Mock Exam 3 - Answers.pdf
question_en: Long-term shifts in population from one country to a neighboring country are best described as which type of geopolitical risk?
explanation_en: Geopolitical risks represent the possibility of things occurring which negatively impact peaceful international relations. Population shifts occur over long periods of time, which is indicative of a thematic risk. Event risk relates to the unknown outcome of specific events where the occurrence date is known. Exogenous risk is related to unanticipated events.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\8. KAPLAN MOCK-1100 MCQs\Mock Exam 3 - Answers.pdf
question_en: A market can be characterized as efficient if assets':
option_a: book values equal their market values.
option_b: intrinsic values equal their book values.
option_c: market values equal their intrinsic values.
explanation_en: In an efficient market, assets' market values should reflect their intrinsic values. Book values seldom equal market or intrinsic values because book values do not reflect investors' expectations.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\8. KAPLAN MOCK-1100 MCQs\Mock Exam 3 - Answers.pdf
question_en: A professional organization most appropriately enforces upon its members:
explanation_en: Professional organizations adopt codes of ethics that govern their members' behavior. Legal standards are enforced by governments or regulatory agencies.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\8. KAPLAN MOCK-1100 MCQs\Mock Exam 3 - Answers.pdf
question_en: A website produces content that it allows the public to view for free. Users may post comments on the site's content if they register with the website and agree to permit it to show them targeted advertisements. The website's business model is best described as being based on:
explanation_en: Hidden revenue is generated from sources other than the user of a product, such as advertising on a free website. Crowdsourcing refers to a business model that depends on user contributions; in this case the website produces its own content. Network effects are increases in the value of a network as its user base increases; based only on the information given this does not describe the website's business model.

question_en: Thomas Baker recently passed the Level III CFA examination. Baker is reviewing a draft of the firm's marketing material to be distributed after he receives his CFA charter. One passage reads, "Baker passed all three Levels of the CFA exam on his first attempts in three consecutive years." Is this statement in compliance with CFA Institute Standards?
option_a: Yes, as long as it is a statement of fact.
option_b: No, because it implies that Baker has superior ability.
option_c: No, because Members or Candidates who passed the exams on their first attempts may not differentiate themselves from those who did not.
explanation_en: Stating that Baker passed the exams in consecutive years is acceptable, if in fact he did so, according to Standard VII(B) Reference to CFA Institute, the CFA Designation, and the CFA Program.

question_en: If an investor uses a threshold return of 0% in calculating the safety-first ratio, which combination of expected returns and standard deviations is most desirable?
option_a: Expected return of 7% and standard deviation of 9%.
option_b: Expected return of 6% and standard deviation of 8%.
option_c: Expected return of 4% and standard deviation of 6%.
explanation_en: With a threshold return of 0%, the safety-first ratio condenses to the expected return divided by the standard deviation, and the most desirable portfolio is the one with the highest ratio. An expected return of 7% relative to a standard deviation of 9% is a ratio of 0.78, which is higher than 6% / 8% = 0.75 or 4% / 6% = 0.67.

explanation_en: Shareholders are the owners of a corporation and have limited liability. Sole proprietors and general partners have unlimited liability.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\8. KAPLAN MOCK-1100 MCQs\Mock Exam 3 - Answers.pdf
question_en: An analyst determines that there is a 60% probability that a stock price will end the year at $12 per share. If there is an equivalent probability that the stock will end the year at either $10 or $16, the expected value of the stock price is:
explanation_en: The expected value is equal to each potential value multiplied by the probability of its occurrence. If there is a 60% probability that the stock price will end the year at $12, an equivalent probability of ending at either $10 or $16 implies a 20% probability of each. The expected value is equal to 0.60 (12) + 0.20 (10) + 0.20 (16) = $12.40.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\8. KAPLAN MOCK-1100 MCQs\Mock Exam 3 - Answers.pdf
question_en: Telling potential investors that a short-term U.S. Treasury fund contains "guaranteed" securities:
option_b: violates the Standards by misrepresenting the securities in the fund.
option_c: violates the Standards by failing to consider the suitability of the fund for potential investors.
explanation_en: Standard I(C) Misrepresentation does not prohibit members and candidates from making truthful statements that some investments, such as U.S. Treasury securities, are guaranteed in one way or another. Suitability does not become a concern until the potential clients take investment action.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\8. KAPLAN MOCK-1100 MCQs\Mock Exam 3 - Answers.pdf
question_en: When a company grants stock options to employees, the company is required to:
option_a: value the options using the Black-Scholes-Merton model.
option_b: disclose how the options aect the income statement and balance sheet.
option_c: recognize the fair value of the options as an expense in the period of the grant date.
explanation_en: Disclosure requirements for employee stock options include their effect on the company's earnings and financial position. The Black-Scholes-Merton model is one method for determining the fair value of stock options, but accounting standards do not specify that this model must be used. As with all share-based compensation plans, both IFRS and U.S. GAAP require the company to estimate the fair value at the grant date and expense it to the income statement over the vesting period.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\8. KAPLAN MOCK-1100 MCQs\Mock Exam 3 - Answers.pdf
question_en: An analyst who believes a company's financial reporting is aggressive would most likely point out:
option_a: low salvage value estimates for xed assets.
option_b: large valuation allowances for deferred tax assets.
option_c: longer useful lives of equipment than those of peer companies.
explanation_en: Aggressive accounting choices will increase reported earnings or improve the company's reported financial position. Estimating a longer useful life for equipment will decrease the annual depreciation expense recorded on the income statement (which increases reported earnings) and decrease accumulated depreciation on the balance sheet (which improves the reported financial position). Low salvage value estimates increase depreciation expense each period, and large valuation allowances decrease a net deferred tax asset on the balance sheet.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\8. KAPLAN MOCK-1100 MCQs\Mock Exam 3 - Answers.pdf
question_en: Tax policy that is designed to minimize its interference with market forces is said to exhibit:
explanation_en: Efficiency, in the context of tax policy, refers to minimizing interference with market forces and disincentives to work. Sufficiency refers to whether tax policy raises enough revenue to meet the government's spending needs. Fairness of a tax policy is commonly expressed in terms of "horizontal equality" (people in similar situations pay similar taxes) or "vertical equality" (richer people pay more taxes).

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\8. KAPLAN MOCK-1100 MCQs\Mock Exam 3 - Answers.pdf
question_en: Which of the following statements is most accurate regarding the GIPS requirement for definition of the firm?
option_a: The firm must be the distinct business entity held out to clients.
option_b: If a firm has offices in different geographical locations, the firm definition may include just the primary location where all the investment decisions are made.
option_c: The firm definition may include the corporation or a subsidiary of the corporation, but the firm cannot be defined as simply a “division” of the corporation.
explanation_en: The GIPS-compliant firm definition must be the corporation, subsidiary, or division that holds itself out to the client as a specific business entity. If the firm has different geographic locations, this firm definition should include all the locations.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\8. KAPLAN MOCK-1100 MCQs\Mock Exam 3 - Answers.pdf
question_en: Which of the following is most accurate regarding information asymmetry in corporations?
option_a: Management has more information than shareholders.
option_b: Shareholders have more information than debtholders.
option_c: The board of directors has more information than management.
explanation_en: Information asymmetry refers to the fact that management has more information about the company than its shareholders. Some debtholders, such as banks, may have more information about a company than is available to the public, including shareholders.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\8. KAPLAN MOCK-1100 MCQs\Mock Exam 3 - Answers.pdf
question_en: Which of the following statements is most accurate regarding parametric and nonparametric tests?
option_a: A z-test is an example of a parametric test, while a t-test is nonparametric.
option_b: Both kinds of tests assume that the underlying data are normally distributed.
option_c: Data that are ranks rather than values are best evaluated using a nonparametric test.
explanation_en: Data that are ranked (ordinal) rather than presented as values are best evaluated using a nonparametric test. Many parametric tests assume the underlying data are normally distributed, but nonparametric tests typically do not. Both z-tests and t-tests are examples of parametric tests.

question_en: A central bank's long-term policy goal for the exchange rate of its domestic currency is most likely to be to pursue:
explanation_en: One of the standard goals for a central bank is for stability in the exchange rate of the domestic currency relative to foreign currencies.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\8. KAPLAN MOCK-1100 MCQs\Mock Exam 3 - Answers.pdf
question_en: Which of the following statements is most accurate about the Standard concerning knowledge of the law? Members and candidates are responsible for violations:
option_a: that are proven by a regulatory authority.
option_b: of which they are aware or should be aware.
option_c: in which they knowingly participate or assist.
explanation_en: Standard I(A) Knowledge of the Law holds members and candidates responsible for violations in which they knowingly participate or assist. The Standard is not limited to violations that are proven by a regulatory authority. Although the Standard strongly encourages members and candidates to report potential violations of which they are aware, the Standard does not require them to do so.
